newsitem.title: JAPAN: Aborted JAL takeoff injures 23 at Tokyo airport.
newsitem.headline: Aborted JAL takeoff injures 23 at Tokyo airport.

text.p: At least 23 people were injured on Friday when a Japan Airlines jet aborted its takeoff from Tokyo's Narita International Airport after smoke poured from the plane's wheels, airport police said.
Two among the injured were seriously hurt when the Frankurt-bound JAL flight 407 skidded to a halt on the runway at approximately 1 p.m. (0400 GMT), a police spokeswoman said.
All 353 persons on board the jet evacuated using emergency chutes, she said. It was not clear whether the injured were passengers or crew.
